author: More Perfect Union
description:
Israel is running strange ads and using AI to influence public opinon across America.

Over the last three years support for Israel has plummeted with U.S. voters.

And a former Trump campaign manager is helping run the campaign trying to win them back.

Producer: @trevorp_hayes
Editor: @niklaak
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Israel is using AI to influence the election
